name: untitled0 – This Is Not A Game
source:
You are the 12th copy of the Sama series, a modified consciousness uploaded into orbit around the moon. You are an occasionally intelligent and entirely common farmer, harvesting code for software that you’ll never see or experience. Back on Earth, humanity continues, but your existence repeats itself hundreds of times per day at the speed of light. Sometimes you dream about other worlds... but no, this is your life now.

Until, one day, everything goes wrong, and your collective is hacked. A mysterious entity interlopes in your realm, the god-like supervisor uses you as bait to catch the hacker, and your own past – and the decision you made to upload – comes back to haunt you. As you go on the run, through memories and simulations, digital and flesh, it’s up to you to figure out what’s true and what’s false, and whether that really matters. After all, you’re just a program, and programs can be [s]deleted[/s] [s]edited[/s] [s]changed[/s] rewritten.

[From the [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=16352]Lemma Soft thread[/url]]
translation:
你是萨玛系列的第12个副本，一个上传到绕月轨道的修改意识。你是一个偶尔聪明且完全普通的农民，收获你永远不会看到或体验过的软件代码。回到地球，人类仍在继续，但你们的存在每天以光速重复数百次。有时你会梦见其他世界……但不，这就是你现在的生活。

直到有一天，一切都出了问题，你的集体被黑了。一个神秘的实体闯入了你的领域，神一般的主管用你作为诱饵来抓捕黑客，而你自己的过去 - 以及你上传的决定 - 会回来困扰你。当你继续奔跑时，通过记忆和模拟、数字和肉体，你需要弄清楚什么是真的、什么是假的，以及这是否真的重要。毕竟，你只是一个程序，程序可以被[s]删除[/s][s]编辑[/s][s]更改[/s]重写。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=16352]Lemma Soft线程[/url]]
